limits: All training fits use synthetic data; no real football or pilot model fit, feature-recipe choice or performance claim.
No search/model-selection loop, nested evaluation, scheduled refitting or post-training reporter is implemented by this increment.
Histories, ratings, information cutoffs and fold-aware state construction remain upstream responsibilities.
Notebook execution and saved nbconvert Lab HTML are verified; live Jupyter frontend validation is outside this increment.
No packages were installed. The full suite has one existing pandas FutureWarning; notebook execution has the existing Windows ZMQ selector warning.
Stored selections are checked for training-row containment and layout, not dataset fingerprint/provenance identity.

Sixteen pinned data/selection files retain their prior hashes. Four live publication manifests point to newer versions; their modification times precede this batch. The saved selections retain their original publication bytes.
